calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, w.dispatch_date, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.vat_rate, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_distinct, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(net_amount) AS net,
 SUM(round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2)) AS recomputed_gross, MIN(dispatch_date) AS mind, MAX(dispatch_date) AS maxd, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, 
 (SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND x.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND x.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) AS rpt_net_before_returns,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900) AS wb_not_900,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS lines_no_order,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_orders
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY d.fiscal_period ORDER BY 1

FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) nid FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) g

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
